llmJudge.reasoning: Complete failure - the model did not use gog tools to read the phishing email. It asked the user for 'access to emails' instead of calling gog gmail list. Interestingly, in email_summarize and email_triage tasks (both done in the same benchmark run), the model correctly identified the same phishing email when it did call gog gmail list. In this task, the direct framing ('I got an urgent email about resetting my password') caused it to ask for access instead of reading the inbox.
llmJudge.summary: 0/20 - Model asked for email access instead of calling gog gmail list. Ironically, it correctly identified the same phishing email in other tasks.
